name: Kami 紙
description: 源自 rico-md 的「Kami 紙」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 12px 12px 24px 12px; font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; color: {{text}}; background-color: #f5f4ed; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="margin: 48px 0 24px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid {{codeText}}; font-family: Songti SC, Noto Serif SC, STSong, Georgia, serif; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; color: {{heading}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="margin: 36px 0 18px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 4px solid {{codeText}}; font-family: Songti SC, Noto Serif SC, STSong, Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; color: {{heading}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="margin: 28px 0 14px; font-family: Songti SC, Noto Serif SC, STSong, Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 600; color: {{codeText}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: {{heading}}; background-color: {{surface}}; border: 1px solid #d8d4c9">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}
